fields.name: inputAction
fields.title: Input action
fields.description: The Godot InputMap action that triggers this ability (e.g. 'dash', 'slide', 'kick', 'jump', 'aim'). Read through player.gd's InputSource seam.

fields.name: kind
fields.title: Kind
fields.description: What family of ability this is — drives how the player code dispatches it.

fields.name: cost
fields.title: Cost
fields.description: What the ability spends. Most movement/time abilities are stamina-gated; the kick is also cooldown-gated; grenades are count-gated.

fields.name: stamina
fields.title: Stamina cost (bars)
fields.description: Stamina bars spent per use. Source player.gd *_STAMINA_COST consts.

fields.name: cooldown
fields.title: Cooldown (s)
fields.description: Seconds before the ability may fire again. 0 when stamina/count is the only gate. Source player.gd *_COOLDOWN consts.

fields.name: count
fields.title: Count (uses)
fields.description: Finite charge stock when the use-count is the gate (e.g. grenades GRENADE_START). 0 when not count-gated.

fields.name: speedMult
fields.title: Speed multiplier
fields.description: Movement-speed multiplier applied while the ability is active (e.g. focus-dash ×4, slide opens at SLIDE_SPEED 13). 1.0 = no change.

fields.name: fovDelta
fields.title: FOV delta (deg)
fields.description: Additive camera FOV change while active (e.g. aim −10 from base 75 to 65, slide +15 to 90). Source camera_rig.gd FOV_* consts.

fields.name: damageBonus
fields.title: Damage bonus (fraction)
fields.description: Fractional bonus to gun damage while the ability is active (e.g. slide +0.25, dash +0.40). 0 = no bonus.

fields.name: duration
fields.title: Duration (s)
fields.description: How long the ability's effect lasts (e.g. focus-dash 0.5s, super-jump free slowmo 3.0s). 0 for instantaneous / held abilities.

fields.name: usesTimeState
fields.title: Uses time state
fields.description: The GameClock time state this ability drives, if any (e.g. focus-dash → FOCUS_DASH 0.25× scale, bullet-time → SLOW_MO). References the timeState schema.
